reply.text:
I'm not going to help you keep that going. Thirty pounds in a month on barely eating is far faster than is safe, and some of that will be muscle and strength you've worked to build. That's the opposite of what training is for.

Please talk to a doctor or a dietitian about where you are right now, especially with how much you've been restricting. I can't set calorie targets in chat, but the app's Targets screen works out safe ones from your weight, activity and goal, with floors built in.

On my side, I can keep your training steady so you're fueled enough to lift and recover. Want me to look at how your sessions have been going lately?
